cohort: The study included all first-time mothers aged 20 years or over with singleton pregnancies in Finland between 2005-2014 (n = 228 348).
finding: The study identified different maternal age 'threshold-ages' for various adverse maternal and infant outcomes, with many occurring earlier than traditional high-risk pregnancy cut-offs of 35 or 40 years.
mod_finding: A threshold-age of 25 years was identified for an increased risk of cesarean section (OR 1.08).
